name: Leave Register
query:
SELECT
  lr.name AS `Reference`,
  lr.employee AS `Employee`,
  lr.leave_type AS `Leave Type`,
  lr.from_date AS `From Date`,
  lr.to_date AS `To Date`,
  lr.total_days AS `Total Days`,
  lr.status AS `Status`
FROM `tabLeave Request` lr
WHERE lr.docstatus < 2
  AND (%(employee)s IS NULL OR %(employee)s = '' OR lr.employee = %(employee)s)
  AND (%(status)s IS NULL OR %(status)s = '' OR lr.status = %(status)s)
  AND (%(year)s IS NULL OR %(year)s = '' OR YEAR(lr.from_date) = %(year)s)
ORDER BY lr.from_date DESC
